description: Anamnesis memory plugins (anamnesis/<case>/<dump>/plugins/<plugin>.jsonl): event.dataset from the plugin's output filename (windows.anamnesis.processes, ...), labels.case/labels.item from the path, host.name the dump the row came from (Volatility rows name no host); evidence time from the row's own time when it carries one — CreateTime (processes, pslist, threads, sessions), Created (network, netstat), UnloadTime (unloaded), LoadTime (modules, when set). Memory rows without an event time keep the ingest time — a snapshot is not an event. ECS process.* copies next to the native PID/PPID/ImageFileName/CommandLine.

grok.description: anamnesis/<case>/<dump>/plugins/<plugin>.jsonl: the case and the memory dump

script.description: the evidence time: the first set field of the plugin's own time columns, in this order
script.source: def order = ['CreateTime', 'Created', 'UnloadTime', 'LoadTime']; for (String f : order) { def v = ctx[f]; if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && !v.startsWith('1970-01-01T00:00:00') && !v.startsWith('0001-01-01')) { ctx._tmp_time = v; break; } }

set.description: Volatility rows name no host: the memory dump stands in
